summary: R2 lifts cleared all R1 blockers. Duration 35 min (7/20/8) within K cap. Refrain 'LINE IT UP — COMPARE — NAME IT!' chanted 3x in BOTH minds_on and consolidation, plus 'My ___ is LONGER than my ___' frame. Rationale cites Piaget (1960) conservation and Sarama & Clements (2009) trajectory; recovery_moves branch 3-ways (A eyeball-guesser, B wrong-end aligner, C same-as-identical conflater). Differentiation has explicit NO-PAPER, NO-PURCHASE PATH (back-to-back, arms, shoes). Worksheet varies format (mixed-order ordering, classroom transfer). All six scored categories = 4.
